_doc.purpose: Localization companion for COM_furniture.json. Holds en-us entries for the wardrobe outfit change COM (com_furniture_changeOutfit). Wording matched to the com_furniture_restroom_fix siblings.

en-us.com_furniture_changeOutfit:
Can be performed when the target's current schedule (faction post or activity) calls for a different outfit. Target will change into that outfit, or back into their default clothes, on command completion.
NPC will look for a spot with a bathroom to change when needed.
en-us.com_furniture_training_shooting_begin_1: $doer.firstname$ stood at the firing position, put on ear protection, raised the weapon in their hand, and began today's training.
en-us.com_furniture_training_shooting_begin_2: $doer.firstname$ adjusted their breathing, aimed at the bullseye, pulled the trigger, and began practicing precision shooting.
en-us.com_furniture_training_shooting_begin_3: $doer.firstname$ repeatedly practiced various shooting stances on the shooting range to improve their shooting skills.
en-us.com_furniture_training_melee_begin_1: $doer.firstname$ stood in the center of the training ground, took a deep breath, adopted a fighting stance, and began today's close-quarters combat training.
en-us.com_furniture_training_melee_begin_2: $doer.firstname$ repeatedly practiced various offensive and defensive movements to improve their fighting ability.
en-us.com_furniture_music_practice_begin_1: $doer.firstname$ tuned up and began today's practice
en-us.com_furniture_music_practice_begin_2: $doer.firstname$ worked through the tricky passages of the score again and again
en-us.com_furniture_medical_checkup_begin_1: $doer.firstname$ had $receiver.firstname$ lie down on the examination bed and began the checkup
en-us.com_furniture_medical_checkup: Give the target a physical checkup. Needs an examination bed.
